scope: Read-only behavioral audit of pinned lalsimulation-v6.2.1 source; no source excerpts, copied coefficients, or implementation recipe.

finite_nu_tortoise_quartic.behavior: The active ordinary-SEOBNRv4 Hamiltonian selects the finite-mass 3PN-truncated tortoise quartic represented by the scalar reference.
finite_nu_tortoise_quartic.remaining_check: Compare the isolated quartic numerically at finite mass ratio and nonzero radial momentum using a compiled pinned binary. The printed Eq. (15) ambiguity remains part of the paper record.

mode_21_spin_residual.behavior: The active ordinary-SEOBNRv4 (2,1) flux path includes the regularized comparable-mass spin residual through v^3, while the complex-waveform path includes only its leading v term. Both omit spin-dependent rho_21 terms through v^3 and retain the published Eq. (29b) spin-dependent rho_21 coefficients at v^4 through v^7 directly, alongside separately hybridized finite-mass nonspin coefficients. The current scalar reference instead adds Eq. (28b) Taylor higher-spin terms as a separate residual. This is a different finite-frequency hybrid.
mode_21_spin_residual.public_equations: Pan et al., arXiv:1006.0431, Eqs. (28b), (29b), (41b); Buonanno, Faye and Hinderer, arXiv:1209.6349, Eqs. (52)-(53a)
mode_21_spin_residual.remaining_check: At identical supplied dynamics with q=4, spins (+0.7,-0.3), M Omega=(0.01,0.02,0.04), compare pre-NQC |h21| for the historical flux and complex-waveform paths and the conditional scalar reference. Check a smooth nonzero equal-mass unequal-spin limit. Derive any correction from public mathematics and verify against a compiled pinned binary.
